up: Find all molecules that appear in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1909281'. Use the document to identify the compound records, then look up the molecule details (ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type) from the molecule dictionary and the canonical SMILES from the compound structures. Return the results ordered by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1909281' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
